description: Merrin & Sallow have just switched on a second sign-in step. Watch passwords escape through ordinary habits, then see the second step hold, give way, and get skipped.
test_objective: Show the second sign-in step inside a working office, and the helpdesk that can undo it: a request that goes unanswered, an approval given to make the requests stop, a code from a fob left on a desk, a number matched on a phone left by the coffee, a screen left open, an account with no second step, and the approvals log that records it all.
